decision: 旧执行序列作废；按主计划 S1-S5 执行，训练前硬闸门未过不得开训

base.f0_f1_f2_init: same official checkpoint, base weights read-only

S1.goal: pod/files/identity: Wan dependency verify + official base identity (8D proprio, 7D action, 32-step horizon, pm1)

S2.goal: 800 data audit (source/dedup/diversity) + gripper V2 repair + real replay video + auto re-collection decision

S3.goal: fingertip force real MuJoCo acceptance + ForceVLA/TacFiLM/ImplicitRDP portability + F0/F1/F2 selection (prefer F2) + fwd/bwd/resume tests

S4.goal: 21k segmented training 3k/6k/.../21k, full resumable checkpoints, 10 distinct eval seeds per milestone, dual-view videos

S5.goal: best checkpoint selection + independent final bare-model test (exact_fill 10 blocks, safety, video)

gates.G2_gripper: V2 semantics + real-control replay + video; no always-closed/jitter
gates.G3_force: ch12-15 verification + processor causal/normalized + F1/F2 integration fwd/bwd
gates.G4_pre_train: all above + batch contains open/close/carry/release + resume test + video recording

storage_policy.on_low_free: pack results/code/checkpoints -> upload HF/GitHub with sha256 -> verify -> delete only regenerable files

gpu_policy.on_low: save+upload all -> GPU_UPLOAD_MANIFEST.json + gpu_restore.py -> verify next instance

operating_rules.tmux: all long jobs in named tmux session (fwv1), logs under /workspace/fwv1/logs
operating_rules.commit: every turn at least one new commit or substantive artifact
operating_rules.bare_model_eval: bare model only; safety guard allowed; G3/M5/oracle/external gripper gating forbidden
